intro.text: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 (SPGFX3) is caused by hemizygous mutation in the CFAP47 gene (301057) on chromosome Xp21.

checks.claim: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 (SPGFX3) is caused by hemizygous mutation in the CFAP47 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: our experimental observations in humans and mice demonstrate that hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia
checks.explanation: The disease name SPGFX3 is OMIM nomenclature, but the paper describes the same causal relationship.

checks.claim: The CFAP47 gene is located on chromosome Xp21.
checks.evidence_quote: permitted the identification of a hemizygous Xp21.1 deletion removing the entire CFAP47 gene
checks.explanation: A deletion at Xp21.1 that removes CFAP47 places the gene at Xp21.

paragraphs.text: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 is a form of primary male infertility marked by asthenoteratozoospermia with multiple morphological abnormalities of the sperm flagella (MMAF). Liu et al. (2021) reported reduced levels of the cilia- and flagella-associated protein CFAP47 in spermatozoa from affected men.

checks.claim: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 is a form of primary male infertility.
checks.evidence_quote: Deleterious variants in X-linked CFAP47 induce asthenoteratozoospermia and primary male infertility.
checks.explanation: The title links the condition to primary male infertility.

checks.claim: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 is marked by asthenoteratozoospermia with multiple morphological abnormalities of the sperm flagella (MMAF).
checks.evidence_quote: Asthenoteratozoospermia characterized by multiple morphological abnormalities of the flagella (MMAF) has been identified as a sub-type of male infertility.
checks.explanation: The paper describes the phenotype as asthenoteratozoospermia with MMAF.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) reported reduced levels of CFAP47 protein in spermatozoa from men affected with X-linked spermatogenic failure-3.
checks.evidence_quote: Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence assays revealed obviously reduced levels of CFAP47 in spermatozoa from all three men harboring deleterious missense variants of CFAP47.

checks.claim: CFAP47 is a cilia- and flagella-associated protein.
checks.evidence_quote: CFAP47 encodes a cilia- and flagella-associated protein that is highly expressed in testis.

paragraphs.text: Liu et al. (2021) reported 3 unrelated Chinese men with primary infertility, asthenoteratozoospermia, and MMAF. Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence showed obviously reduced levels of CFAP47 in spermatozoa from all 3 men. The authors also studied a cohort of severely asthenoteratozoospermic men from Australia. All men with hemizygous CFAP47 variants had typical MMAF phenotypes.

paragraphs.text: Liu et al. (2021) found hemizygous CFAP47 variants in affected men, consistent with X-linked recessive inheritance. They concluded that hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can cause X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia. They contrasted this with the MMAF genes identified previously, which showed autosomal recessive inheritance.

paragraphs.text: Liao et al. (2022) screened 7 men with MMAF for gene mutations. In 1 man they found 2 novel missense mutations in the CFAP47 gene: c.706G-A, which causes a val236-to-met (V236M) substitution, and c.1337C-T, which causes a thr446-to-met (T446M) substitution. CFAP47 was dramatically reduced in this man's spermatozoa.

paragraphs.text: Liao et al. (2022) found that CFAP47 interacted with WDR87 in the flagellar midpiece of mouse spermatozoa. WDR87 was highly expressed in human and mouse testis and localized to the middle piece of the sperm tail. In spermatozoa from an MMAF patient with CFAP47 mutations, WDR87 expression was significantly decreased, with weak signals next to the sperm nuclei. The authors suggested that CFAP47 is needed to transport WDR87 during sperm flagella biogenesis.

checks.evidence_quote: we identified a cilia- and flagella-associated protein, CFAP47, which interacted with WDR87 in the flagellar midpiece of the spermatozoa
checks.explanation: The interaction in the flagellar midpiece is stated, but the abstract does not say the spermatozoa were mouse.
